lines.zh: 这段河床的石头我都认得。
lines.en: I know every stone in this riverbed.
The surface glare makes me squint.
I've swept a line across the sand.
My gills are full of river mud.
Downstream the water turns colder.

lines.zh: 河湾转了半天，还是这条。
lines.en: Circled the bend forever; still this same spot.
One after another—don't scatter.
I'll rest only past this shoal.
The current carries me to the mangroves.
Going downstream, I don't have to try.
I know every turn of this bend.

lines.zh: 芦苇根划了一下我的侧腹。
lines.en: A reed root scraped my flank.

lines.zh: 河里成群游的，都是我们。
lines.en: The schools in this river are all ours.

lines.zh: 红树林的水根挡住了路。
lines.en: Mangrove roots block the way.

lines.zh: 红树林的浑水里，我最自在。
lines.en: In the murk of the mangroves, I'm most at ease.
I blow a bubble as a greeting.
I circle the riverbed in schools.
River weeds tangle my tail.
River bass, swimming in schools.

lines.zh: 河湾这块石头，是我常待的。
lines.en: This river-bend stone is my usual spot.

lines.zh: 水草摇一下，我也摇一下。
lines.en: The weeds sway once; so do I.

lines.zh: 河底的石头，我都记得形状。
lines.en: I know the shape of every river stone.

lines.zh: 水面上的浮萍，又厚了一层。
lines.en: The duckweed on top has grown thicker.

lines.zh: 河底的石头缝，我挨个看。
lines.en: I check each gap between the river stones.
I know every stone on this riverbed.
The river's cold runs through my gills.

lines.zh: 就这样漂在沼泽里也不坏。
lines.en: Drifting in the swamp like this is fine.

lines.zh: 沼泽的水温一夜没变，正好。
lines.en: The swamp water holds its warmth all night.
Gills opening and closing—that's rest.
How many in this river now?

lines.zh: 在水草里一停，我就打瞌睡。
lines.en: Pausing in the weeds, I doze off.

lines.zh: 贴着河底的石头，我不想动。
lines.en: Pressed to the riverbed stones, I stay still.
In the swamp water, I swim in schools.
You carry the iron smell of a hook.

lines.zh: 水下那双眼，一直没挪开。
lines.en: Those eyes underwater have not looked away.
You've shattered the moonlight on the water.

lines.zh: 岸上那两根腿，站得真直。
lines.en: Those two legs on the bank stand very straight.
You smell of dry things.

lines.zh: 你踩进河里，泥都翻起来了。
lines.en: You stepped in and stirred up the mud.
Your shadow fell and the water darkened.

lines.zh: 你站在岸上，影子先下来了。
lines.en: You stand on shore; your shadow comes first.

lines.zh: 你的脚比河底的石头还笨。
lines.en: Your feet are clumsier than river stones.
A scale's flipped up—it stings.
My scales go dark in the swamp.
My pectoral fin's hurt; I swim crooked.
Don't squeeze—a fish body is soft.
My tail's heavy—can't paddle.
I need a gulp of air, quick.
Who put a hook in the water?
I'll back off into deeper water.
I can squeeze into the riverbed cracks.
That iron taste in the water is blood.
In a river school, I stand out.
A smell drifting through the water.
What fell from the bank over there?
Something bright, can I eat it?

lines.zh: 这味儿顺着水飘过来的。
lines.en: That smell drifted down with the current.

lines.zh: 一点点碎屑，就够我转圈。
lines.en: A few crumbs and I circle for them.

lines.zh: 沼泽的水有点浑，正好躲。
lines.en: Marsh water is murky; good for hiding.
One ripple and I rise.
One nibble, just one.

lines.zh: 沼泽里一层浮萍，我钻过去。
lines.en: I nose through the duckweed in this swamp.
After the bump you swim off fast.

lines.zh: 河底的石头也没这么硬。
lines.en: Even riverbed stones aren't this hard.
One step and the whole bottom shakes.
I tilted but didn't tip over.
I'm riding downstream—don't block me.
Don't press—my scales are flattened.
You take upstream; I take downstream.
You scraped scales off me!
My tail nearly tangled in the weeds.
You've broken up my school.

lines.zh: 沼泽的鱼群，挤一挤总能过去。
lines.en: The swamp school is thick; I squeeze through.

lines.zh: 河底的青苔，我啃过一遍。
lines.en: I've grazed the riverbed moss.

lines.zh: 红树林的根，替我们挡着。
lines.en: The mangrove roots shield us.
The crevice in the riverbed is home.

lines.zh: 沼泽水里，我们挤成一团。
lines.en: In swamp water we crowd together.
The eggs sink into this shallow mud.
One flick of my tail and I turn.
The scales on your flank are bright.
The cool river is just right for the eggs.

lines.zh: 河湾的沙窝，我给你留好了。
lines.en: I kept a sand hollow in the river bend for you.

lines.zh: 河底的坑，我扫得很干净。
lines.en: I swept this riverbed hollow clean.
The eggs cling to stone; I keep watch.

lines.zh: 河里这么多吃的，我先收着。
lines.en: So much food in this river; I keep some.
Shiny—into my hollow it goes.
Found on the bottom—mine now.
I can dig a pit in the riverbed.

lines.zh: 这玩意儿硬邦邦，鱼都咬不动。
lines.en: This is so hard that fish cannot bite it.
Sunken, but I can carry it.
In rivers and swamps we school together.
Held in my mouth, it pricks a little.
My mouth is full—it pries my gills open.

lines.zh: 河底怎么会有这种东西？
lines.en: How did this end up on the riverbed?

lines.zh: 这条鱼太大，我咬着不放。
lines.en: This fish is too big; I will not let go.
Something stirs in the river grass.
That one's fat—worth a chase.
Got a bite, and I never let go.
Hidden in riverweed, my mouth moves first.
That one fell behind—perfect.
In the river, we school and turn.
Swamp water is warmer than the river.
In these shallows, hold still for a moment.

lines.zh: 河底的鲈鱼，尾巴绷紧了。
lines.en: The river bass's tail has gone taut.
Lots of stones; I hug the bottom.
I saw your ripples first.
I wait among the riverbed stones.
I follow where the river runs.

lines.zh: 这片芦苇根，我天天在底下转。
lines.en: These reed roots, I circle them every day.
You run upstream; I follow upstream.
The river is only so wide—where will you hide?
In the shallows, you've nowhere to hide.
The water's getting shallow; you can't run.

lines.zh: 沼泽的水，我一口一口滤。
lines.en: I filter the swamp water mouthful by mouthful.
A bass's teeth go for soft spots.
A butt of the head, a sweep of the tail.
The more you struggle, the harder I bite.
This bite lands on your ankle.
I threw my whole body at you!
In a school, I'm not so small.

lines.zh: 红树林的水根间，我钻来钻去。
lines.en: I weave through the mangrove roots.
This stretch of riverbed is mine to rule.
That tail slap lands solid.
This hollow in the riverbed is mine.
The school waits mid-river.
Egg shell still stuck to my fin.
Just hatched, and already drifting.
The school passed. I follow.
First a lap of the bend to learn it.

lines.zh: 浑水正好，藏得住我的背。
lines.en: Muddy water suits me—it hides my back.
The river washes over my back—good.
We crowd under the water weeds.
I swim hugging riverbed stones.
I've been back to this tributary before.
The surface burns—I sink lower.
Flung onto the bank, my gills dry out.
Can't hold it — put me back in water.
The water flashed white from the blast.

lines.zh: 箭扎穿了我的背鳍，好疼。
lines.en: An arrow pierced my dorsal fin—it stings.
The water tastes wrong—like potion.
I can't crack the snails on the riverbed.
Lightning hit the river; my scales stand up.
Under the void, there is not even water.
